meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'учиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to learn', paired with 'учиться'.
